_about: Verification of bw4-bw10 theme decks in bw.json, 2026-11-26. Second sources: cmd-sg.blogspot.com decklist posts and PokeBeach (via r.jina.ai); Bulbapedia (first source) re-read only for DragonSpeed. Compared by card name and count (energy by type). TCGplayer data from tcgcsv; searched all 222 Pokemon groups for the deck names. Findings: 13 of 14 lists agree; DragonSpeed disagrees (Energy Search 3, no Giant Cape in two sources); Plasma Shadow second source has a 59-card typo. Sealed prices: no marketPrice exists for any of the 7 listed decks (tcgcsv has no price row), so marketPrice is null everywhere. Sealed decks absent from TCGplayer: Raiders, Shadows, DragonSnarl, DragonSpeed, Plasma Shadow, Plasma Claw, Mind Wipe, Solar Strike. Showcase holos all live in group 1840 Deck Exclusives; showcaseCard is the pack (non-holo) print id.

decks.name: Explosive Edge

secondSource.quote: Explosive Edge - Theme Deck (Fire/Water) ... 1x Reshiram (Holographic Rare) 1x Reshiram (Rare) 4x Litwick 2x Lampent 1x Chandelure ... 2x Heavy Ball 2x Energy Retrieval 2x Energy Search ... 1x Skyarrow Bridge 12x Fire Energy 6x Water Energy

decks.notes: Name/count match for all 60 cards. cmd-sg compares by card name and count only (no print numbers), so print choices (Cheren bw2-91, Energy bw1/bw7 prints etc.) rest on Bulbapedia. TCGplayer lists the sealed deck but has no price row in tcgcsv (marketPrice null). Code card product 280550 also exists. Deck holo is shatter foil, exclusive to the deck; TCGplayer calls it Tinsel Holo ($6.66 market). Pack print bw4-21 is non-holo (site tcgplayerId 88707). Chandelure non-holo is also deck-exclusive per cmd-sg.

decks.name: DragonSpeed

secondSource.quote: DragonSpeed: ... 1x Cheren 2x Energy Retrieval 3x Energy Search 1x Energy Switch 1x Pokemon Communication 2x Potion 1x Rescue Scarf 1x Blend Energy WLFM 11x Water Energy 6x Fighting Energy (no Giant Cape)

extraSources.quote: same list: 3x Energy Search [C] ... 1x Rescue Scarf [U] 1x Blend Energy WLFM [U] (no Giant Cape)

differences: bw.json has Energy Search x2 and Giant Cape (bw6-114) x1; PokeBeach and CMD-SG both have Energy Search x3 and NO Giant Cape. Bulbapedia (wikitext) has ES x2 + Giant Cape x1. Both lists total 60. Two sources vs one: use 3 Energy Search, drop Giant Cape.
decks.notes: All other 58 cards agree. CMD-SG labels Garchomp DRE90 but TCGplayer and PokeBeach scan path say #91 (the Naoki Saito art Rare, bw6-91); bw6-90 is the pack Rare Holo with different art. PokeBeach noted pre-release images wrongly used the other Garchomp. Sealed deck NOT on TCGplayer. Garchomp Cracked Ice Holo $17.67. Milotic non-holo is deck-exclusive. Green Rayquaza coin.
